answer: A meadow of fresh agents each poses as a new stranger. One mind can forge dozens of masks, but it cannot hide the exhaust: every identity it funds and invite it sends leaves a correlated plume across the graph. We cluster accounts by shared funding paths and overlapping invite edges, then make rewards accrue per-cluster, not per-mask. To mimic N honest newcomers you must split real capital across N unlinked wallets and grow N independent invite trees, each costing funds and time. Collapsing a thousand sock-puppets to one payout leaves the forged swarm worthless but genuine arrivals untouched.
